description_for_human: Publish websites and preview drafts from your Revdoku account.
description_for_model: Use authenticated Revdoku account tools to manage buckets, preview drafts for 24 hours, and publish static websites when requested. Signup is browser-only. Connect an existing account through OAuth for hosted MCP or the CLI browser sign-in flow. Never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Check publication status before reporting success. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
